content.json:
# Aspire showcase API
Health of the API in the `web` Container App, with its PostgreSQL database, for finding out what is wrong: start on **Overview**, then follow the failing part. Deployed from `src/AspireShowcase.AppHost/workbooks`; changes made in the portal are overwritten on the next deploy.

content.title: In the selected time range

content.query:
requests
| extend status = case(toint(resultCode) >= 500, "5xx", toint(resultCode) >= 400, "4xx", "ok")
| summarize count() by status, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Requests by status

content.query:
requests
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Latency (ms)

content.query:
requests
| summarize requests = count(), server_errors = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500), client_errors = countif(toint(resultCode) between (400 .. 499)), avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 1), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 1), p99_ms = round(percentile(duration, 99), 1) by name
| order by server_errors desc, p95_ms desc
content.title: Endpoints, worst first

content.query:
let deps = dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser"
| summarize database_calls = countif(type contains "postgres"), database_ms = sumif(duration, type contains "postgres") by operation_Id;
requests
| join kind=leftouter deps on operation_Id
| summarize requests = count(), request_ms = round(avg(duration), 1), database_calls = round(avg(coalesce(database_calls, 0)), 1), database_ms = round(avg(coalesce(database_ms, 0.0)), 1) by name
| order by request_ms desc
content.title: Where the time goes, per endpoint (averages per request)

content.query:
requests
| top 50 by duration desc
| project timestamp, name, resultCode, duration_ms = round(duration, 1), operation_Id
content.title: Slowest requests (paste operation_Id into Trace lookup)

content.query:
requests
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500
| summarize count() by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Server errors (5xx) by endpoint

content.query:
exceptions
| where client_Type != "Browser"
| summarize count() by type, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Exceptions by type

content.query:
let exc = exceptions
| where client_Type != "Browser"
| summarize arg_min(timestamp, type, outerMessage) by operation_Id
| project operation_Id, exception = type, message = outerMessage;
requests
| where toint(resultCode) >= 500 or success == false
| join kind=leftouter exc on operation_Id
| project timestamp, name, resultCode, duration_ms = round(duration, 1), exception, message, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Failed requests with their exception (paste operation_Id into Trace lookup)

content.query:
exceptions
| where client_Type != "Browser"
| summarize count = count(), first_seen = min(timestamp), last_seen = max(timestamp), sample_operation_Id = take_any(operation_Id) by type, outerMessage, method
| order by count desc
content.title: Exceptions, most frequent first

content.query:
traces
| where client_Type != "Browser" and severityLevel >= 2
| project timestamp, level = case(severityLevel == 2, "Warning", severityLevel == 3, "Error", "Critical"), message, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Warning and error logs

content.json: PostgreSQL calls made by the API (the `app` database, through EF Core and Npgsql).

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "postgres"
| summarize queries = count(), failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Queries and failures

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "postgres"
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Query duration (ms)

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "postgres"
| extend statement = iff(isempty(data), name, data)
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(success == false), avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 2), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2), total_ms = round(sum(duration), 1) by statement
| order by total_ms desc
content.title: Statements, by total time

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and type contains "postgres"
| where success == false
| project timestamp, statement = iff(isempty(data), name, data), resultCode, duration_ms = round(duration, 1), target, operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Failed queries (paste operation_Id into Trace lookup)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name startswith "db.client.connection"
| summarize value = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Connection pool (Npgsql metrics)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name startswith "db.client" or name startswith "npgsql"
| summarize average = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 3), samples = sum(valueCount), latest = max(timestamp) by name
| order by name asc
content.title: All database client metrics

content.json: The notifications service and the API calls into it: the API sends a notification after a to-do item is added or removed. Custom telemetry from `NotificationTelemetry.cs` in the service and `NotificationsClient.cs` in the API. A scheduled job in the service, `NotificationDigestJob`, sums up what was recorded since its last run; its span is a trace of its own, with a span link to each `notifications.record` span it covers.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "notifications.received"
| summarize notifications = sum(valueSum) by kind = tostring(customDimensions.kind), bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Received by the service, by kind (notifications.received, counter)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "notifications.stored"
| summarize stored = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Kept in memory (notifications.stored, gauge)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "notifications.message.length"
| summarize average = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), longest = max(valueMax) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Message length, characters (notifications.message.length, histogram)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("notifications.received", "notifications.digested")
| summarize notifications = sum(valueSum) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Received and summed up by the digest job (notifications.received, notifications.digested, counters)

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and name == "notifications.digest"
| extend links = todynamic(tostring(customDimensions["_MS.links"]))
| project timestamp, notifications = toint(customDimensions["notifications.count"]), linked_spans = array_length(links), duration_ms = round(duration, 2), operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Digest runs (a run with nothing new records no span)

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and (target contains "notifications" or data contains "notifications")
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(success == false), avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 2), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2) by name, resultCode
| order by calls desc
content.title: Calls from the API to the service

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and name startswith "notifications."
| summarize calls = count(), failed = countif(success == false), avg_ms = round(avg(duration), 2), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2) by name
| order by calls desc
content.title: Operations in the service (custom spans)

content.query:
traces
| where client_Type != "Browser" and message startswith "notification."
| project timestamp, event = message, service = cloud_RoleName, details = tostring(customDimensions), operation_Id
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Span events (paste operation_Id into Trace lookup)

content.query:
dependencies
| where client_Type != "Browser" and name == "notifications.digest"
| mv-expand link = todynamic(tostring(customDimensions["_MS.links"]))
| project timestamp, digest_trace = operation_Id, digest_span = id, linked_trace = tostring(link.operation_Id), linked_span = tostring(link.id)
| join kind=leftouter (dependencies | where name == "notifications.record" | project linked_span = id, linked_name = name, kind = tostring(customDimensions["notification.kind"]), recorded = timestamp) on linked_span
| project timestamp, digest_trace, linked_name, kind, recorded, linked_trace, linked_span
| order by timestamp desc, recorded asc
content.title: Span links of the digest: one row per notification it summed up (paste linked_trace into Trace lookup)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("http.server.active_requests")
| summarize value = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Requests in progress

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("dotnet.process.memory.working_set", "dotnet.gc.last_collection.heap.size")
| summarize value = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Memory (bytes)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("dotnet.thread_pool.thread.count", "dotnet.thread_pool.queue.length")
| summarize value = sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount) by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Thread pool

content.query:
requests
| summarize instances = dcount(cloud_RoleInstance) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Running instances

content.query:
traces
| where message startswith "Application started" or message startswith "Now listening on" or message startswith "Application is shutting down"
| project timestamp, message, cloud_RoleInstance
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: App starts and stops (a start nobody deployed is a crash or a restart)

content.json:
Everything recorded for one trace in one place. Paste a trace ID (`operation_Id` in the other tabs, the trace ID in the Aspire dashboard) or the ID of one span in it. The trace has to fall inside the time range picked above.

A span link points from one trace to another: the digest job's trace links to the traces whose notifications it summed up. The span links panel lists both directions; paste `other_trace` to follow one.

Metrics carry no trace ID, so the last two panels show what the services reported in the 5 minutes before and after the trace, as context. For a waterfall chart of the same trace, paste the trace ID into Transaction search in Application Insights.

content.title: Trace
Spans, as a tree: the pasted span with everything above and below it

content.query:
let input = trim(" ", "{TraceOrSpanId}");
let spans = union
(requests | project timestamp, id, parentId = operation_ParentId, operation_Id, service = cloud_RoleName, span_kind = "request", name, detail = url, duration, result = resultCode, failed = (success == false)),
(dependencies | project timestamp, id, parentId = operation_ParentId, operation_Id, service = cloud_RoleName, span_kind = iff(type =="InProc", "internal", type), name, detail = data, duration, result = resultCode, failed = (success == false));
let op = toscalar(spans | where operation_Id == input or id == input | take 1 | project operation_Id);
let names = spans | where operation_Id == op | project spanId = id, span = name;
union
(traces | where operation_Id == op | project timestamp, record = iff(isempty(tostring(customDimensions.CategoryName)), "event", "log"), severityLevel, message, service = cloud_RoleName, spanId = operation_ParentId, details = tostring(customDimensions)),
(exceptions | where operation_Id == op | project timestamp, record = "exception", severityLevel = int(3), message = strcat(type, ": ", outerMessage), service = cloud_RoleName, spanId = operation_ParentId, details = tostring(details))
| extend level = iff(record == "event", "", case(severityLevel >= 4, "Critical", severityLevel == 3, "Error", severityLevel == 2, "Warning", severityLevel == 1, "Information", "Verbose"))
| join kind=leftouter names on spanId
| extend in_pasted_span = iff(spanId == input, "yes", "")
| project timestamp, record, level, message, span, in_pasted_span, service, details, spanId
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Logs, span events and exceptions, in order

content.query:
let input = trim(" ", "{TraceOrSpanId}");
let spans = union
(requests | project timestamp, id, parentId = operation_ParentId, operation_Id, service = cloud_RoleName, span_kind = "request", name, detail = url, duration, result = resultCode, failed = (success == false)),
(dependencies | project timestamp, id, parentId = operation_ParentId, operation_Id, service = cloud_RoleName, span_kind = iff(type =="InProc", "internal", type), name, detail = data, duration, result = resultCode, failed = (success == false));
let op = toscalar(spans | where operation_Id == input or id == input | take 1 | project operation_Id);
union requests, dependencies
| where isnotempty(customDimensions["_MS.links"])
| mv-expand link = todynamic(tostring(customDimensions["_MS.links"]))
| extend linked_trace = tostring(link.operation_Id), linked_span = tostring(link.id)
| where operation_Id == op or linked_trace == op
| extend direction = iff(operation_Id == op, "link", "backlink")
| project timestamp, direction, linking_span = name, service = cloud_RoleName, other_trace = iff(direction == "link", linked_trace, operation_Id), other_span = iff(direction == "link", linked_span, id), span_in_this_trace = iff(direction == "link", id, linked_span)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Span links: spans this trace links to (link), and spans in other traces that link to it (backlink)
Around the trace: request, database and outgoing call duration (ms)
Around the trace: every metric reported
